messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed a weird double-credit pattern in billing for resumed streaming sessions after a fallback. Happens when router falls back to a smaller model mid‑stream and then the client reconnects and resumes.
aj: Can you paste a minimal repro/log? I haven't seen duplication in our tests.
maria: Here's a trimmed log sequence (obf ids). you can see suffix token range is captured twice across two provisional ledgers:
```
2026-03-18T14:12:01Z router: route -> model-A (primary)
2026-03-18T14:12:03Z runtime: fallback -> model-B (latency spike)
2026-03-18T14:12:04Z client reconnect session=abc123 resume_offset=512 snapshot_id=snap-57
2026-03-18T14:12:05Z runtime: emit tokens (offset 512..589) provisional-ledger entry id=p-900
2026-03-18T14:12:07Z router: replay -> model-A
2026-03-18T14:12:08Z runtime: emit tokens (offset 512..589) confirmed-ledger entry id=c-901
```
So provisional entry p-900 and later confirmed c-901 both cover the same suffix range.
chris: That matches a hypothesis we discussed — we only dedupe by session+offset in the provisional window. When the fallback path replays the same suffix under a different model/route, the ledger stitching doesn't find the provisional because snapshot ids differ.
maria: Right. Current stitch key: `session_id + offset` which breaks when snapshot_id changes on fallback. Proposing stitch-key: `session_id + snapshot_id + offset + suffix_hash`.
aj: Adding snapshot_id helps but could still double-charge if client reconnects without snapshot (older clients). We need fallback logic: if no snapshot_id, fall back to weak dedupe but treat charges as provisional until confirmed.
kevin: For console UX, we should surface provisional vs confirmed charge rows. Suggestion: add a small yellow "provisional" badge in token billing table and a diff column that shows `pending_confirmed_tokens`.
chris: Also we should add telemetry to detect frequency. PromQL idea:
```
sum by (route,env) (increase(streaming_provisional_tokens[5m]))
/
sum by (route,env) (increase(streaming_confirmed_tokens[5m]))
```
Alert if ratio > 0.08 for >10min on production canary.
maria: Implementation plan I propose:
- require clients to send `X-Snapshot-Id` and `X-Resume-Offset` on resume requests (backfilled header)
- ledger: compute dedupe_key = sha256(session_id + snapshot_id + resume_offset + suffix_hash)
- provisional entries hold dedupe_key and expire after 2m
- on confirm, atomically mark provisional -> confirmed; if a duplicate confirmed exists, merge and mark delta=0

aj: We should gate the server-side behavior behind feature flag `ledger-stitch-v2` and rollout to 5% of router traffic, monitor billing divergence + errors.
kevin: For older clients that don't send snapshot, ledger should fall back to `session_id+offset` plus a short provisional window and send a telemetry counter `resume_missing_snapshot` so we can decide when to require clients.
replay-bot: job run: stitch-v2-canary @ deploy-3421 completed in 2026-03-19T03:11Z — small traffic run with 5% canary. logs: https://ci.internal/runs/3421
chris: One more edge: tool calls. If the stream includes a toolcall that truncates (tool returns EOF early) and the client reconnects, we can end up charging for the same tool tokens twice because toolcall handling is currently split across provisional and confirmed ledgers. Proposal: treat toolcalls as atomic ledger units and attach tombstone id on provisional so duplicates are ignored.
maria: Agreed. I'll draft RFC with schema changes for ledger rows and a short migration plan. Will include console mockups (yellow provisional badges + session snapshot column) and telemetry queries.
kevin: Assign to maria + aj to own the RFC. I'll make a task in the rollout board and add canary monitoring thresholds.
aj: I'll implement server flag + minimal dedupe logic. maria — can you add header docs and console mocks?
maria: Yep. Will post RFC by EOD and link to the canary run.
chris: Nice. :thumbsup: If we see unexpected divergence during canary, we'll quick rollback the feature flag.
kevin: Thanks team — great cross-stack coordination. :rocket:
